title: Moonbeam Alphabet
hook: Gravity stays; motion changes what weight can feel like.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: two calm beats before target reveal
visualStyle: soft 3D moon-and-galaxy storybook, silver blue lavender palette, glowing edges, uncluttered foreground composition

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child comparing lunar gravity with orbital free fall
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: gentle 3/4 with grounded moon steps and legato orbital phrases
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written gravity/motion contrasts; hardware and distant astronomy remain separate
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: gravity cue -> recall beat -> target -> hop/glide/point gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a soft celesta shimmer and tiny synth-air swell after the target, leaving the word itself dry and clear.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a soft celesta shimmer and tiny synth-air swell after the target, leaving the word itself dry and clear
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Moonbeam Alphabet about gravity and motion: lunar surface gravity, orbital microgravity, spacecraft control and dust all behave differently; the song uses float imagery only where physics supports it.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child compares standing on Moon, orbiting in free fall, drifting inside spacecraft, and operating equipment; 'float' becomes a precise contrast rather than a universal space verb.
semanticArc: deep-space targets and return to human controls
